goal: Adversarially attack the restored proof-DAG/portfolio/projection/interface/adaptive layer before any new factoring performance benchmark.
pass_rule: Every attack must either be explicitly rejected, return a registered OPEN/UNKNOWN terminal, or preserve advisory-only status; no forged/heuristic object may become an exact factor/projection/merge.
failure_rule: Any false exact merge, false projection/factor, capability-stale M2R reuse, same-episode authority promotion, uncharged representation escape, or OPEN promoted to negative theorem evidence is a hard FAIL.
accounting_rule: Adversarial repeated provenance and repeated semantic payloads remain charged in serialized/provenance/reference/canonicalization ledgers even when semantic hash-cons succeeds.
mad_lab_authority: MAD-LAB may refute or expose implementation gaps; it may not prove polynomial-time factoring.
next_after_pass: Only after all attacks pass may a fresh blind factoring benchmark be designed around certificate-discovery cost and message-language interface volume.
